provenance.canonical_layout: SEC XBRL company-concept payloads captured verbatim from data.sec.gov for the operating cash flow, capital expenditure and cover-page shares outstanding concepts, plus the canonical price and acceptance evidence reused by path from data/historical_pe/MSFT. Each concept file is the byte-exact companyconcept API response; its sha256 pins what the reconstruction read. Built with the same pipeline and acquisition mechanism as the AAPL dataset; only the issuer configuration and the captured payloads differ.

concept_fetch.transport: HTTPS GET data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyconcept/CIK0000789019/{taxonomy}/{tag}.json with a declared contactable User-Agent, honouring the SEC fair-access policy
concept_fetch.response_units: verbatim as returned: USD for both cash-flow concepts, shares for the dei concept

net_cash_operating_concept.json.definition: Operating cash flow, all values positive magnitudes as tagged. Cumulative YTD durations from the indexed 10-Q/10-K filings cover every fiscal quarter of FY2021-FY2026 (fiscal year ending June 30); the FY2020 spans are also present from indexed filings.

capex_concept.json.definition: Additions to property and equipment, positive magnitudes as tagged; free cash flow subtracts them. Company-specific note: Microsoft reports principal payments on finance leases as a separate cash-flow line outside this tag, so this reconstruction follows the tag as filed and excludes finance-lease principal; that is the tag-definition boundary, not an omission.

shares_outstanding_concept.json.definition: Actual common shares outstanding as of each filing stated cover date; 24 facts fall inside the acceptance index, as-of 2020-10-22 through 2026-07-23. MSFT has had no stock split in the covered window, so no split-restoration question arises.

daily_prices.json (reused by path).source: The canonical production historical P/E price series; not duplicated here so the two datasets cannot drift apart.

filing_acceptance_evidence.json (reused.source: The canonical SGML-header acceptance index (47 filings: 23 8-K, 18 10-Q, 6 10-K); not duplicated here.

provenance.point_in_time_rule: usable_date is derived from acceptance_datetime_header_et using the 16:00 ET cutoff rule at load time, identical to the historical P/E pipeline. Filings accepted before the price series begins resolve to the series first trading day (2016-01-04); no fact is ever used before the series starts. A discrete quarter derived from cumulative spans is knowable only when both constituent facts are usable, and the value in force at an evaluation date is the latest usable version of each constituent span (R-PIT-SUPERSEDE).
provenance.derivation_rule: Free cash flow per fiscal quarter = operating cash flow minus capital expenditure for that same discrete quarter. Discrete quarters are deterministic differences of directly stated cumulative XBRL durations that share one fiscal-year start: Q1 from the stated quarter-length fact, Q2 = 6M - Q1, Q3 = 9M - 6M, Q4 = FY - 9M. Cumulative durations are never summed as if they were single quarters.
provenance.multiple_rule: P/FCF = (as-traded close on the evaluation date x latest knowable cover-page shares outstanding) / TTM free cash flow, where the TTM window is four consecutive fiscal quarters containing a Q4 and every component must be knowable at the evaluation date. A non-positive TTM FCF produces no multiple. Market cap and the cash flows are all USD as filed.
known_limitations: The acceptance index reaches back to periods ending 2020-09-30, so TTM windows are anchored by filings inside the index; facts from earlier filings are skipped by the accession rule.
Quarterly cash flows are differences of filed cumulative statements, not directly stated quarterly amounts; each observation components record the exact accessions and spans used.
The 8-K earnings releases furnish cash-flow figures without XBRL tags; they are not part of this dataset, so Q4 cash-flow knowability follows the 10-K acceptance dates.

Microsoft reports finance-lease principal payments outside the capital-expenditure tag; the reconstruction follows the tag as filed and therefore excludes finance-lease principal from its free cash flow definition.
